items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I got a call from Herbie Mann. Herbie said he was coming out in a couple of months or something, on his way to Japan and would I join him to go there and work a gig in Japan.

ctx.x: And I guess I was still having some kind of fight within myself to get on course of who I was and what I was doing and where my, the direction of my future and all that was happening. I went to San Francisco and I stayed over in Oakland in a really dump hotel. I just wanted to hibernate. I didn't want to hang out in San Francisco, I just wanted to be up there where nobody's know I was around, or be asking about taking a gig or playing and all that. I was just trying to get my head together. And I went to Oakland.

In the meantime, just before I left Los Angeles, I got a call from Herbie Mann. Herbie said he was coming out in a couple of months or something, on his way to Japan and would I join him to go there and work a gig in Japan. I had never been in Japan -- still haven't -- and I was saying, 'Wow, this is great.' But I told Herbie, I said, 'Herbie, call me back a little later. I can't answer that now because I've got some things pending. And if you haven't found anybody in the next few weeks, call me again closer to…

But I knew right then that I wasn't ready to just start accepting jobs, even going to Japan, which I always wanted to do. And working with Herbie wasn't a drag, but I just couldn't get my head together.
